patch.value: Candidate B1B delivers a Markdown-to-static-site generator as a monolithic CLI (O1) using thin-slice milestones. Milestone 1 produces a working CLI that ingests a folder of .md files and outputs bare HTML pages with preserved formatting (R1–R4, R11, R22). Milestone 2 adds forward-link detection, backlink computation, and backlink section rendering (R9, R10, R21). Milestone 3 introduces tag extraction and per-tag navigation pages (R7, R8, R20). Milestone 4 delivers client-side search index generation and search UI (R5, R19). Milestone 5 polishes the tool with error reporting (R12), cross-browser validation (R13), watch mode (R25), and optional features (R24, R26–R29). Blocking questions Q1 (link syntax) and Q2 (tag format) must be resolved before coding begins. XSS mitigation (K3) is enforced from day one by disabling raw HTML and blocking unsafe URL schemes. HITL interruption triggers apply to blockers and security-sensitive decisions; milestone exit reviews should include stakeholder verification where required by policy. This branch optimises for speed-to-first-value and simplicity at the cost of long-term extensibility.
